title: On the finite group whose proper enhanced power graph is claw-free
summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. The \emph{enhanced power graph} of $G$, denoted by $\mathcal{E}(G)$, is the graph with vertex set $G$ in which two vertices $u$ and $v$ are adjacent if and only if there exists an element $w \in G$ such that both $u$ and $v$ belong to $\langle w \rangle$. The \emph{proper enhanced power graph} of $G$, denoted by $\mathcal{E}^{**}(G)$, is the subgraph of $\mathcal{E}(G)$ induced by the non-dominating vertices.
